# EZ-Tree authoring source

Daniel Greenheck, https://github.com/dgreenheck/ez-tree
Revision: `dcf309bd86bd521083d9c70f01f2de45fdc7c457`, MIT (see LICENSE).

Only authoring code is included. Changes: local Three r180 import; explicit `.js`
extensions; preset JSON inlined in an ESM module for browser/Node compatibility.
No runtime request is made to upstream services. Original code otherwise unchanged.

Upstream bark notice: `src/app/public/textures/LICENSE.md` states ambientCG bark
is CC0 1.0 and bundled leaf textures use the project MIT license.
